name: Reproduced DAVIS-2016 25-frame evaluation protocol v2
mask: Read palette indices with PIL; (annotation != 0).astype(uint8)*255; preserve originals

vda.context: All original frames within EACH sequence, separately
vda.normalization: One min/max over T,H,W within each sequence; never dataset-global or per-frame
vda.invalid_policy: Nonfinite depth, zero sequence span, empty mask or mismatched frame IDs stop; no silent skip

vepi.definition: author edge_batch.py BGR grayscale, Sobel ksize3 magnitude, reference/mask INTER_LINEAR resize, 5x5 rectangular dilation, mask>127, Pearson; mean frames then equal-weight mean videos
vepi.limits: AIF self-comparison can score 1 without bokeh; fixed visual review of background defocus, focus leakage, boundaries and temporal flicker is required. No new BER metric. Paper-description Laplacian differs from public code.

baseline_rules.shared_external_input: Original RGB + VDA q/255 + quantized focus + K16, first25
baseline_rules.BokehMe: Keep frozen Normalized adapter and gamma2.2; per-frame span rescaling retained, no K compensation
baseline_rules.BokehDiff: Keep frozen Normalized-B adapter; per-frame span rescaling retained, no K compensation
baseline_rules.MPIB: Keep frozen gamma2.2 configuration and original shared disparity coordinates
baseline_rules.DrBokeh: Full-public LDF+LaMa with shared VDA; DAVIS mask only focus/VEPI, never alpha/layer input
baseline_rules.AnyToBokeh: Shared VDA/focus/K16 with public whole-video overlapping inference
baseline_rules.scope: Shared external source does not imply identical physical CoC across internal adapters

deeplens.runtime: native TF1.15 CPU, oneDNN disabled, original BGR graph and single SR
deeplens.rgb_preflight_resize: cv2.INTER_LINEAR original to1024x576, float32/255; cv2.INTER_AREA to512x288
deeplens.mask_low_grid: nearest-neighbor original palette-union binary mask to512x288
deeplens.focus_point: mean of native DepthNet values inside low-grid foreground; argmin absolute distance among foreground pixels; ties choose first row-major index
deeplens.focus_scope: Our deterministic foreground-mean-matched focal-point adapter, not a recovered private ATB setting
deeplens.preflight_selection: Fixed before outputs: animals, thin structures, multiple foreground parts, deformation, fast motion and camera motion; no metric-based selection
deeplens.aperture_source: Official evaluator_interactive.py Slider valinit=5 divided by10; user selected after preflight, without VEPI evaluation
deeplens.aperture_scope: Fixed native-default convention; no claim of physical equivalence to shared K16 or recovery of the private ATB mapping
deeplens.gate: Native8-scene preflight and aperture convention resolved; remaining DAVIS method input preflights precede full50-scene sweep
